meta.title: Custom Groups
meta.description: Tailor-made guided nature programmes in India for families, friends, private groups, clubs, companies, international visitors, schools and universities.

hero.title: A trip built around your group
hero.lede: Families, friends, clubs, companies, visitors from abroad, schools and universities: tell us who is coming and what you want to experience, and we will design a guided programme around your dates, pace, interests and comfort.

groupTypes.title: Every kind of group
groupTypes.intro: Our default is a well-guided nature holiday, not a classroom field course.

items.title: Families
items.body: Gentle-paced nature days with safaris, short walks, birding, viewpoints, local food and enough downtime for mixed ages.

items.title: Friends & private groups
items.body: Your own departure on your dates, with a dedicated guide, a route shaped around your interests and a daily rhythm you choose.

items.title: Clubs & societies
items.body: Birding, photography and natural-history groups: target birds, mammals, butterflies or macro subjects, low-light rainforest sessions and patient field support.

items.title: Companies & retreats
items.body: Nature immersion, team days, lodge-based wildlife, landscape trails and guided forest walks, planned around your schedule.

items.title: International visitors
items.body: Route notes, comfort planning and guided wildlife time shaped around your flights.

customise.title: What can be customised
customise.intro: We shape the programme around what your group wants: safaris, birds, mammals, forests, wetlands, mountains, night trails, local food, photography time and comfortable travel.

options.detail: Tigers, leopards, elephants, hornbills, Western Ghats endemics, pheasants, frogs, reptiles, butterflies, orchids or other habitat specialities. We plan for the best chance, never a guarantee.
Relaxed holiday, safari-focused, photography-focused, adventurous monsoon, family-friendly or academic.
Jeep safaris, birding, night walks where rules allow, wetland visits, waterfall stops, mountain trails, local markets and checklist sessions.
Lodge category, safari intensity, walking difficulty, rooming preferences and food needs.
Half-day guiding, weekend breaks, 4–7 day tours or longer multi-region routes.

sampleDay.title: A sample group day
sampleDay.lede: An example only. The rhythm changes with the season, weather, permits, ages and the group’s energy.
sampleDay.caption: A sample day on a custom group programme

rows.what: Guided safari, birding, wetland or forest walk while wildlife is most active
Breakfast, checklist notes and free time
Village, landscape, river, forest, tea, spice or viewpoint visit, depending on the region
Lunch and rest through the hottest or wettest part of the day
Forest-edge walk, safari drive, photography session, wetland visit or scenic drive
Optional night walk for frogs, reptiles, owls, moths and rainforest sounds, where rules allow

academic.title: Academic options when you need them
academic.intro: Our naturalists include past and present environmental-science lecturers at Bishop Heber College, Tiruchirappalli, with experience of nature camps and field-based learning for schools and colleges. <link>Meet the naturalists</link>

items.title: Short modules
items.body: Three to five day programmes introducing tropical ecology, species observation and conservation through time in the field.

items.title: Field courses
items.body: Longer programmes for colleges and universities, with field methods, data recording, student projects and review sessions.

items.title: Youth camps
items.body: Structured camps with age-appropriate nature walks, activities, observation skills and guided group reflection.

safety.title: Safety & logistics
safety.intro: Every custom programme is planned around group size, ages, walking ability, weather, forest access, travel time, food needs and safe wildlife watching.
logistics: Airport or rail pick-up, where practical
Accommodation matched to your comfort and budget
Route notes, packing guidance and target-species lists
safety.healthBody: Every member of the group, students and staff included, needs comprehensive travel medical insurance and must tell us about any medical condition or allergy before booking. Many routes are remote, and the nearest hospital can be hours away.

cta.title: Tell us what your group wants
cta.lede: Share your dates, group size, ages, interests, budget range and comfort level. We will suggest a route and a guided programme.
